findings.title: Contribution license section links ./LICENSE which does not exist (root ships LICENSE-MIT/LICENSE-APACHE)
findings.description: CONTRIBUTING.md:274-277 License section states 'Contributions are licensed under the same terms as the project' and hyperlinks [MIT OR Apache-2.0](./LICENSE) - but Test-Path confirms no plain LICENSE file exists at root; the project ships LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE only. The contribution-license-grant link 404s in any renderer that resolves relative links (GitHub, editors, the book).
findings.root_cause: License section written against the conventional single-file LICENSE layout; never reconciled with the dual-file MIT+Apache arrangement the repo actually uses.
findings.impact: Minor but real: a contributor following the grant link hits a 404 at the exact moment they are confirming under which terms they contribute. Also mildly ambiguous whether the grant intends both files (it does - 'same terms as the project').
findings.recommendation: Point the link at both files: [MIT](./LICENSE-MIT) OR [Apache-2.0](./LICENSE-APACHE), matching README's License section wording. Alternatively add a root LICENSE pointer file, but the two-link fix is conventional.

findings.fix_guide: 1) Edit CONTRIBUTING.md:277 to the dual-link form. 2) Sweep for other './LICENSE' references (grep found none besides this one in legal-adjacent docs). 3) Verify rendering on GitHub.
